titulo: Campaign Call No. 01: the cost of electric vehicles in Brazil
resumo: Funds creator projects to accelerate the electrification of the Brazilian fleet, showing the public what it really costs and what it saves to move from a combustion car to an electric one.
apresentacao: The campaign exists to accelerate the electrification of the Brazilian fleet. The obstacle is not only price: it is what people believe about price. Charging costs, real range, maintenance and resale value are settled in everyday conversation, and that is where the campaign has to be.

Instead of hiring a single influencer to repeat a ready message, the call buys design capacity from several creators at once. Each selected project pursues the same objective through its own strategy, format and narrative, and directs its audience to the campaign participation channel.
INDICA runs the call as responsible intermediary and shares delivery with Koko.
escopo: Original projects that generate public conversation about the cost of electric vehicles in Brazil.
Projects that direct the audience to the campaign participation channel.
Creators as individuals or companies, small collectives and communication agencies.
Any audience size and any niche: eligibility belongs to the project, not to the channel's usual subject.
Written or video proposals, with an itemized budget.

criterios.descricao: Strength of the idea, the narrative and the format proposed.

criterios.titulo: Expected reach relative to the creator's scale
criterios.descricao: What is assessed is the reach expected given the audience size of whoever proposes, not the size itself.
How well the project takes the audience to the campaign participation channel.
Coherence between scope, budget and schedule.

distribuicao.observacao: Only one project can receive the R$ 50,000 ceiling.
The selection panel may award an amount different from the one requested.
